Data & privacy

Void Striker 2 is playable as a guest. There is no external account registration, player chat, real-money shop or additional analytics SDK in this build.

Progress and account display

On CrazyGames, the CrazyGames Data Module stores progression and preferences; the platform manages guest and account synchronization. Off-platform, this game uses this browser's local storage. Your CrazyGames username and official avatar are displayed when you are signed in; the avatar loads from CrazyGames image servers.

Online co-op, when configured

A room server receives your verified CrazyGames identity or generated guest session, control inputs, room status and combat results. Reward receipts are retained for up to 30 days, capped at 500 per pilot. Rooms are temporary and do not survive a server restart. The hosting provider may process connection/security logs under the publisher's hosting policy. Co-op is not active in this standalone build until a server is configured.

Advertising

Ads are disabled by default for Basic Launch. If enabled for Full Launch, optional videos and menu banners use only the CrazyGames SDK. Normal solo play, purchases with earned points and missions do not require ads. Videos do not advance or repair play streaks.

Questions and data controls

Use CrazyGames account controls for platform-held data. Contact the game publisher for data held by a configured room server. Clearing browser storage does not delete a CrazyGames cloud save or server reward records.

PUBLISHER PRIVACY POLICY ↗

This notice describes the game implementation. The publisher must supply their contact/policy details and ensure their deployed service follows applicable privacy requirements.
